items.title: Chris Parker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 5, 2023
items.q: I mentioned this other group I have, East Coast Meeting, with a great singer, Dennis Collins... We have met a couple of times and have started writing stuff together

ctx.x: Thank you for that. What’s up next for you?

We’re going to start on another, the next trio album. I’ve got four and a half or five things kind of ready, and we’re going to rehearse next week. And I’ve got kind of a time crunch because the bass player Ameen Saleem now lives in Rome so he’s only in New York for — I think he leaves at the end of February. And the holidays and all that stuff kind of — everybody was busy with family stuff so next week we’re going to start rehearsing these new tunes of mine and try to get a feel for them and then maybe go into…

good. We’re talking like going into the studio maybe not February, maybe March, and start putting these things down. And there’s live gigs with that group and with a chamber ensemble, a couple of other things going on.
